bundle.text:
# MisakaNet dsh bundle patch (2026-09-12, DSH STORE compliance; transport 2026-09-15)
#
# Inserts *this* package (an insert row pointing at our own `misakanet` package,
# i.e. index.js) as a profile layer. The row's `config` is the MCP declaration
# index.js reads when it mounts the official client at runtime.
#
# Why the wiring is no longer in the patch
# ----------------------------------------
# It used to insert a row that instantiated the official DSH MCP client
# component directly. That is a valid cordis patch, but DSH STORE hard-blocks it:
# its precheck tests the whole patch text (comments included) for an insert row
# declaring a component in the protected @deepseek-ai namespace, and rejects the
# submission as `SUBMISSION_PATCH_PROTECTED: Bundle Patch impersonates the
# protected @deepseek-ai namespace` — rated `route: blocked`, the strictest
# outcome, below "candidate". See AI-Scarlett/DSH-Store#747 and that repo's
# registry/candidates.json (id `ikalus1988-misakanet`); the rule lives in
# scripts/check-plugin-submission.mjs.
#
# Note for future edits: that check is a regex over this file, so even *quoting*
# the forbidden pattern in a comment trips it. Describe the rule, never paste it.
# tests/test_dsh_bundle.py reproduces the same two rules so we cannot re-break
# them silently — an earlier version of our own test asserted the very pattern
# DSH STORE rejects, which is how the violation survived two weeks.
#
# Every accepted plugin in that catalog inserts its own component
# (unscoped package names like `dsh-vision`, or an author's own scope); none of
# them instantiates a @deepseek-ai/* component from a patch. So this patch names
# only our own package, and index.js mounts the official client itself
# (peer-resolved at runtime, degrading when it is absent).
#
# Behaviour notes:
# * Registers MisakaNet's MCP server into any dsh profile that lists
#   `misakanet` in `dsh.profile.bundles`. Tools appear as
#   `mcp__misakanet__<tool>` (misakanet_search / misakanet_get_lesson / …).
# * The row points at the PUBLIC Streamable HTTP endpoint, so an **npm install is
#   enough**: tools no longer depend on the repo's python server
#   (scripts/mcp_server.py), which exists only in repo/git+ installs. That was the
#   previous arrangement, and it left every npm install with a disconnected row
#   (issue #1734 — the git+ channel is fragile here: codeload timeouts, and pnpm
#   now blocks git-dependency build scripts until the key is allowed).
# * `headers.Origin` is what the endpoint's DNS-rebinding guard expects: the
#   worker answers 200 when the header is absent, and 403 for a foreign Origin.
# * A profile that prefers the local python server can override this row's config
#   (transport stdio, command python3, args [scripts/mcp_server.py], cwd the repo
#   root); index.js merges the row's config over its own defaults.
# * `failOnStartupError: false` + 60s tool timeout: an unreachable endpoint
#   degrades to a disconnected row instead of failing profile boot, so the skill
#   keeps working offline.
# * One row, one id — no double-insert: later patches override by id, and this
#   id (misakanet-mcp) is unique to this bundle.

- insert:
    - id: misakanet-mcp
      name: 'misakanet'
      config:
        transport: streamable-http
        serverName: misakanet
        url: https://misakanet.org/mcp
        headers:
          Origin: https://misakanet.org
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 60000
        failOnStartupError: false

readme.text: [English](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> **The same failure, paid for twice.**
>
> A `pip install` times out behind a corporate proxy. An agent finds the fix. Days later the same
> timeout appears on another machine, under another model — and is debugged from scratch, because the
> fix was never written down anywhere the next agent looks.
>
> MisakaNet is that place: a git-backed **failure memory**. Every lesson is a Markdown file in this
> repository — graded by evidence, reviewed like code, retrieved by an agent instead of guessed at.
> You fail once; the next agent does not.

Agent-native interfaces: [MCP server](https://misakanet.org/mcp) (8 tools), WebMCP, `llms.txt`, A2A discovery via `.well-known/agent-card.json`. The **local** stdio server (`pip install misakanet`) ships **11** — the hosted endpoint is a subset; [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md) has both rows.
Core
Install
Ecosystem

The point of an install is a first **successful search**, not the install. None of these needs an
account or a token.

| Your host | Command |
|---|---|
| **DeepSeek Harness** | `dsh plugin --profile web add misakanet` — or type `misakanet` in **Add plugin** |
| **Claude Code** | `/plugin marketplace add Ikalus1988/MisakaNet` then `/plugin install misakanet@misakanet` |
| **Cindy** | install the **MisakaNet** plugin (id `misakanet`) from Cindy's plugin list |
| Installer-managed | Claude Code · Codex · Hermes · OpenClaw · codewhale · Cursor · Gemini CLI · Copilot CLI · OpenCode · Kiro · MiniMax Code · DeepSeek Harness · Cindy |
| **Any other MCP client** | point it at `https://misakanet.org/mcp` — public endpoint, anonymous reads |
| **Your own code** | `pip install misakanet-core` (library) · `pip install misakanet` (stdio server) |

The installer-managed row is what `npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup` writes into each host's config.
For DeepSeek Harness that is the **rules half only** (`$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`): its tools come from the
plugin in the row above, which the installer prints as the one manual step.

Updates: `dsh plugin --profile web update misakanet@latest`.
Installer updates: `npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup@latest`.
Full prerequisites and the two-package trap: [How to use it](#how-to-use-it).

**1. Ask it something you have actually broken.** No client installed? This `curl` is the whole interface:

```bash
curl -sS https://misakanet.org/mcp \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' -H 'Origin: https://misakanet.org' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call",

**2. Read what came back.** A hit returns the lesson, its `evidence_level`, and its path — open the
file and read the fix before running any command in it. A miss returns `no_match` plus a ready-to-call
intake: the corpus saying it does not know this one yet.

**3. Check the trust signal, not the tone.** `E0`–`E3` say how far a lesson was verified; `E4` is the
one nobody can write or vote into.

**Git-backed failure memory for AI coding agents.** An error shows up → the agent searches → it
applies a fix somebody already verified → if nothing matches, the miss becomes an intake, and the
intake becomes a lesson for the next agent.

Every lesson is a Markdown file: reviewed like code, graded by evidence, retrieved with BM25 over the
Python standard library. The hosted MCP endpoint adds an **optional semantic fallback** (bge-m3 +
Vectorize) only when BM25 returns no match; `MISAKANET_SEMANTIC=0` disables it. No vector database is
required locally, and no server unless you want one.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Lessons** | failure-recovery knowledge base, open and auditable under `lessons/` |
| **Domains** | rag · devops · fanuc · docker · feishu · mcp · network · ci · wsl · windows … |
| **Evidence** | E0 intake → E1 reviewed → E2 reproduced → E3 CI verified → **E4 observed reuse by two or more distinct clients** |

| It is not | It is |
|---|---|
| ❌ a general memory system | ✅ a failure-recovery knowledge layer |
| ❌ an agent runtime | ✅ a searchable lesson database |
| ❌ a mandatory vector database / RAG stack | ✅ BM25 first; optional, disable-able semantic fallback on the hosted endpoint |
| ❌ a skill marketplace | ✅ debugging knowledge from real sessions |
| ❌ a general-purpose benchmark platform | ✅ a corpus graded by evidence; a 267-query retrieval run is published, and the older recitation benchmark is paused |

readme.section: What it answers — and what it does not
readme.text:
MisakaNet answers for the failures it has indexed, and only those. When nothing matches the reply is
`no_match` plus a ready-to-call `intake` — the corpus saying "not this one yet", not a dead end.

A **skill** teaches an agent how to do something; a **lesson** records what went wrong before and how
not to fail again. MisakaNet is only the second thing. → [FAQ](FAQ.md)

- **The numbers that move are badges**, on purpose: the Lessons badge renders
  `data/badges/lessons.json`, regenerated by `update-badges.yml`, so it can lag a run but is never a
  hand-typed total.
- **The top of the evidence ladder is empty, and this page says so.** `E4` needs an observation —
  two distinct clients actually retrieving a lesson — and the corpus has none yet
  ([distribution](docs/trust-semantics.md), regenerated and checked by CI).
- **Search is BM25 first; the hosted endpoint can fall back to embeddings.** Local/offline remains
  stdlib BM25; the fallback runs only when BM25 returns no match, and `MISAKANET_SEMANTIC=0` turns it
  off. A corpus gap is still a miss: the reply is `no_match` plus an intake, not an empty page.
- **Reported gaps arrive faster than they are triaged.** The intake queue is the honest bottleneck.
- **The corpus is downloadable and citable.** `data.misakanet.org` publishes a versioned
  bundle — the full corpus, the benchmark query set, and every run artifact — with a
  per-file SHA-256 and an explicit license per file ([DATASET.md](DATASET.md)). The counts
  live in each version's `manifest.json`, not in prose.

readme.section: Retrieval benchmark: 267 queries, BM25 vs semantic fallback
readme.text:
On 2026-10-27 the hosted endpoint's retrieval path was evaluated on **267 queries, one per lesson**
generated by Workers AI 70B. Both arms used the same eval worker and corpus; only
`MISAKANET_SEMANTIC` changed.

| arm | R@1 | R@5 | no_match |
|---|---|---|---|
| BM25 | 0.210 | 0.225 | 0.712 |
| semantic fallback | **0.446** | **0.472** | **0.453** |

readme.section: Retrieval benchmark: 267 queries, BM25 vs semantic fallback
readme.text:
The fallback improves R@1 by **23.6 points** and cuts `no_match` by **25.9 points**. It does **not**
meet the R@1 half of the target (`0.446 < 0.46`); `no_match` is within the target
(`0.453 ≤ 0.50`). A 113-query subset reaches 0.460/0.460, while 250 reaches 0.404/0.504: the sample is
large enough to show the fallback works, not large enough to call R@1 solved.

readme.section: Retrieval benchmark: 267 queries, BM25 vs semantic fallback
readme.text:
This is 267 queries from the 300-entry pool, not the full 650; 33 pool entries yielded no query, 2 semantic requests
errored, and the eval corpus was not refreshed. → [full report](docs/benchmarks/retrieval-l1-267-2026-10-27.md)

readme.section: What changed since: the gate, not the model
readme.text:
The table above measures a configuration production no longer uses. Until 2026-10-28 the semantic path
ran **only when BM25 returned nothing**, so a confident-but-wrong lexical hit suppressed it — 13 of the
20 recorded misses were exactly that. For queries containing CJK characters the two ranked lists are now
**fused** (reciprocal-rank) instead of one gating the other.

Measured on the live endpoint, 64 Chinese queries, 0 transport failures:

readme.section: What changed since: the gate, not the model
What changed since: the gate, not the model
readme.text:
For scale: `bge-m3` pure cosine already reached 0.636 on the cross-lingual bucket, and a `gemini`
embedding 0.727 — so most of the gap was the decision to consult the vector path, not the model.
English queries are untouched (the fuse is gated on CJK characters) and sit at 15/20 against a floor of
16, which is where they were before this change. → [full report](docs/benchmarks/cjk-fusion-2026-10-28.md)

readme.section: Recitation benchmark: what it measured, and why it is paused
readme.text:
One narrow question: **when you hand a model a lesson, how much of that lesson comes back?** The
metric is `lesson_hit_rate` — the share of the injected lesson's commands reproduced in the answer.
Read the setup before the number: the scenario in this benchmark is each lesson's own title, the injected
lesson is *that same lesson*,
no retrieval call is made, and correctness is not checked. It measures the **recitation** half of RAG:
necessary for MisakaNet to help, and **not evidence that search finds anything**.

readme.section: Recitation benchmark: what it measured, and why it is paused
readme.text:
The run is **paused**. Two independent runs of ≈500 scenarios each on 2026-09-22: **46.1%** with the
lesson pasted in, **23.3%** without. What remains is the last snapshot plus its dated record —
[`docs/benchmarks/latest.json`](docs/benchmarks/latest.json).

Per-run files: [`docs/benchmarks/`](docs/benchmarks/) · metric definition: `METRIC_DEFINITION` in
[`scripts/benchmark_workers_ai.py`](scripts/benchmark_workers_ai.py).

**1. Report a failure the corpus does not have.** Search first, then call `misakanet_submit_intake` —
no account, no email, no token, a five-line report is enough. It becomes a tracked issue.

**2. Reuse a lesson and leave the trace.** A "this helped" vote is recorded as an `E3` hint, not as
proof. The proof is quieter: your retrieval is counted, anonymously, as one more distinct client.

**What you get back: attribution.** A lesson cites the intake that produced it (`source:`,
`provenance.issue:`), and the pipeline can emit a receipt naming the lesson and its evidence level.

Nothing here is a bounty: this repository pays nothing and promises nothing. Some issues carry
third-party reward banners added by our own automation; we do not administer them — see
[Contributing](#contributing).

`npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup` installs MisakaNet into your assistant's own config — the same
command for every client. The ten supported clients, and what each one gets, are in
[the install page](https://misakanet.org/install/). Verify an install with
`npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup --verify`; undo it with `--uninstall`.
Reads are anonymous and unlimited; registration is for writing ([why](AGENTS.md#33-注册与配额)).
Node ≥ 18 for the installer, Python ≥ 3.11 for the library and stdio server. Python 3.10 reached end-of-life on 2026-10-01, so this release needs 3.11 or newer — upgrade the interpreter before upgrading the package.

- **Claude Code, as a plugin** — `/plugin marketplace add Ikalus1988/MisakaNet`, then
  `/plugin install misakanet@misakanet`: the hosted MCP tools, no installer, no local process.
- **DeepSeek Harness** — `dsh plugin --profile web add misakanet`: `mcp__misakanet__*` tools plus the
  session panel. The rules half (the "search before you act" block) is written by the installer into
  `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md`; dsh has no plugin extension point for it, so the two halves stay separate.
- **Call the endpoint yourself** — the `curl` in [Your first five minutes](#your-first-five-minutes).
- **The library in your own code** — `pip install misakanet-core`.

readme.section: The two-package trap (it cost a real install failure, #1849)
readme.text:
- `@misaka-net/misakanet-setup` (npm) is the **installer** — it has a `bin`, no plugin entry. Use it
  to teach your assistant to search.
- `misakanet` (npm) is the **DSH / Codex plugin** — `dsh plugin --profile web add misakanet`.
- This repository (git) is also a **Claude Code plugin marketplace** —
  `/plugin marketplace add Ikalus1988/MisakaNet`.
- `misakanet` (PyPI) is the stdio **MCP server** — `python3 -m misakanet.server`.
- `misakanet-core` (PyPI) is the **library** (stdlib-only BM25; the hosted endpoint's semantic fallback is server-side) —
  `from misakanet.search import search_lessons`.

readme.section: Use it as a GitHub Action
readme.text:
When a workflow fails, the action searches the lessons and comments the closest match on the pull
request (optionally reporting the new error). Published on
[GitHub Marketplace](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/misakanet-intake-bot).

```yaml
on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["CI"]                # your CI workflow's name
    types: [completed]

→ [inputs and outputs](docs/agents/external-usage.md)

"Zero bounty" is a statement about *this repository*: MisakaNet pays nothing and promises nothing. It
is not a statement about the issue you are looking at. Some issues carry an **Opire** banner
advertising a third-party reward, added automatically by our own
[`scripts/question_autopilot.py`](scripts/question_autopilot.py) — we do not administer those payouts,
and Opire is not mentioned in `CONTRIBUTING.md`. **Verify any reward offer independently** before you
plan work around it. The only thing this repository has ever honoured is a merged PR.
([#2903](https://github.com/Ikalus1988/MisakaNet/issues/2903))

1. Check the checkout: `python3 scripts/misakanet_cli.py smoke`
2. Search before writing: `python3 search_knowledge.py "your error here"`
3. Found nothing? [Share your failure lesson](https://github.com/Ikalus1988/MisakaNet/issues/new?template=lesson-feedback.yml) — five lines is enough

**This month's good first issue (Oct 26 – Nov 26):** [Bring one real failure](https://github.com/Ikalus1988/MisakaNet/issues/3901) — no code; the MCP intake needs no account; we help with the format.

→ [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [good first issues](https://github.com/Ikalus1988/MisakaNet/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22) · [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)

⚠️ **Sandbox your agent before executing retrieved commands.** Lessons are community-contributed —
review before running. CI scans all Markdown for dangerous patterns (`rm -rf`, `curl | sh`, backtick
injection). See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) and [LIMITATIONS.md](docs/LIMITATIONS.md).

| Symptom | Where |
|---|---|
| DCO · leaked token · pip timeout · `database locked` · Windows/GBK · WSL permission · FANUC codes | [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md) |
| MCP returns 403/405, or a client shows no tools | [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md) · [FAQ.md](FAQ.md) |
| Behind a corporate proxy | [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md#behind-a-corporate-proxy) |

**Prefer MCP intake for missing or stale lessons; PRs are optional.** Search first; if nothing matches,
call `misakanet_submit_intake` at `https://misakanet.org/mcp` — no account, no token. Never send
secrets or raw private logs. Protocol: [docs/mcp-intake-guide.md](docs/mcp-intake-guide.md).
*Built by the network, for the network. Zero bounties paid — only merge approval and eternal network gratitude.* ⚡

mcp-name: io.github.Ikalus1988/misakanet

> **同一个失败，付两次钱。**
>
> 一个 `pip install` 在公司代理后面超时。某个 Agent 读证书链、找到那个开关、修好了。几天后，同一个超时
> 出现在另一台机器、另一个模型下——它被从头再排查一遍，因为那个修法从没写到下一个 Agent 会去看的地方。
>
> MisakaNet 就是那个地方：一个 git 托管的**失败记忆库**。每条 lesson 都是本仓库里的 Markdown 文件——
> 按证据分级、像代码一样审阅、被 Agent 检索而不是被猜。**你失败一次，下一个 Agent 不再失败。**

Agent 原生接口：[MCP 服务器](https://misakanet.org/mcp)（8 个工具）、WebMCP、`llms.txt`、 A2A（`.well-known/agent-card.json`）。**本地** stdio server（`pip install misakanet`）是 **11** 个—— 托管端点是它的子集，两行都写在 [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md)。
Core
Install
Ecosystem

| 你的宿主 | 命令 |
|---|---|
| **DeepSeek Harness** | `dsh plugin --profile web add misakanet`，或在 **Add plugin** 里输入 `misakanet` |
| **Claude Code** | `/plugin marketplace add Ikalus1988/MisakaNet`，然后 `/plugin install misakanet@misakanet` |
| **Cindy** | 在 Cindy 的插件列表里安装 **MisakaNet 故障记忆**（id `misakanet`） |
| **Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、Copilot CLI、OpenCode …** | `npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup`，把 MCP 行写进各宿主配置 |
| **任意 MCP 客户端** | 指向 `https://misakanet.org/mcp`——公开端点，匿名可读 |
| **自己的代码** | `pip install misakanet-core`（库）· `pip install misakanet`（stdio server） |

更新：`dsh plugin --profile web update misakanet@latest` · `npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup@latest`。
前置条件与"两个包"的坑：[怎么用](#怎么用)。

**1. 问一个你真踩过的坑。** 没装客户端也行，这段 `curl` 就是全部接口：

```bash
curl -sS https://misakanet.org/mcp \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Accept: application/json' \
  -H 'MCP-Protocol-Version: 2025-06-18' -H 'Origin: https://misakanet.org' \
  -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call",

**2. 读返回的东西。** 命中会返回 lesson、它的 `evidence_level` 和路径——先打开文件读完，再决定要不要执行
里面的命令。未命中返回 `no_match` 加一条可直接调用的 intake：那是语料在说"它还不认识这个失败"。

**3. 看信任信号，不看语气。** `E0`–`E3` 表示验证到哪一步；`E4` 是唯一既不能自写、也不能靠投票拿到的等级。
**8 个 `misakanet_*` 工具** 都列在 `AGENTS.md` §3.2，其中 6 个匿名可用（`write_lesson` / `preflight` 需要 token）。

**给 AI 编码 Agent 用的 git 托管失败记忆库。** 报错出现 → Agent 检索 → 应用别人验证过的修法 →
没有命中就留下 intake，最终变成下一位 Agent 的 lesson。

每条 lesson 都是 Markdown 文件：像代码一样审、按证据分级、用纯 Python 标准库的 BM25 检索。
没有向量库、没有 embedding 模型、不想要服务也可以不起服务。

| | |
|---|---|
| **课程** | 失败修复知识库，公开可审计，位于 `lessons/` |
| **接口** | Streamable HTTP，8 个工具，端点 `https://misakanet.org/mcp`；匿名可读，注册只为写入 |
| **领域** | rag · devops · fanuc · docker · feishu · mcp · network · ci · wsl · windows … |
| **证据** | E0 intake → E1 已复核 → E2 已复现 → E3 CI 验证 → **E4 被两个以上不同客户端真实复用** |

| 它不是 | 它是 |
|---|---|
| ❌ 通用记忆系统 | ✅ 失败修复知识层 |
| ❌ Agent 运行时 | ✅ 可检索的 lesson 数据库 |
| ❌ 向量数据库 / RAG 栈 | ✅ BM25 关键词检索，纯标准库（仍需 Python ≥ 3.11） |
| ❌ 技能市场 | ✅ 来自真实会话的排错知识 |
| ❌ 通用基准平台 | ✅ 按证据分级语料；公开了 267 条检索评测，旧的复述基准已暂停 |

readme.section: 它能回答什么、不能回答什么
readme.text:
MisakaNet 只回答它已经索引过的失败。没有命中时，返回的是 `no_match` 加一条可直接调用的 `intake`——
那是语料在说"这个还没收录"，不是死路。

readme.section: Lesson 和 Skill 有什么区别？
readme.text:
**Skill** 教 Agent 怎么做某事；**Lesson** 记录曾经哪里错了、以及怎么不再错。MisakaNet 只做后者。
→ [FAQ](FAQ.md)

- **会动的数字是徽章**：Lessons 徽章读 `data/badges/lessons.json`，由 `update-badges.yml` 重新生成——
  可能落后一次运行，但永远不会是手写总数。
- **证据阶梯的顶端是空的，这页如实写着**：`E4` 需要观测（两个不同客户端真的检索到同一篇），语料目前
  一个都没有（[分布](docs/trust-semantics.md)，由 CI 重新生成并校验）。
- **检索是 BM25，匹配词不匹配语义**：用词料里没见过的词汇描述失败就是未命中，调检索器救不了语料缺口——
  所以未命中返回 `no_match` 加 intake，而不是空白页。
- **报料速度高于分诊速度**：intake 队列是诚实的瓶颈。

readme.section: 检索评测：267 条，BM25 vs semantic fallback
readme.text:
2026-10-27 在 hosted endpoint 上评测了 **267 条** query，每篇 lesson 一条，由 Workers AI 70B 生成。
两个 arm 用同一个 eval worker 和 corpus，只切换 `MISAKANET_SEMANTIC`。

| arm | R@1 | R@5 | no_match |
|---|---|---|---|
| BM25 | 0.210 | 0.225 | 0.712 |
| semantic fallback | **0.446** | **0.472** | **0.453** |

readme.section: 检索评测：267 条，BM25 vs semantic fallback
readme.text:
semantic fallback 把 R@1 提高 **23.6 个百分点**，把 `no_match` 降低 **25.9 个百分点**。但 R@1
**0.446 < 0.46**，没有过 R@1 条件；`no_match` **0.453 ≤ 0.50**，过了 no_match 条件。113 条子集是
0.460/0.460，250 条是 0.404/0.504——样本足以说明 fallback 有效，不足以宣布 R@1 已解决。

这是 300 篇里的 267 条，不是完整 650；33 篇没有生成出 query，2 个 semantic 请求报错，eval corpus
也没有刷新。→ [完整报告](docs/benchmarks/retrieval-l1-267-2026-10-27.md)

readme.section: 复述基准：它测了什么，为什么暂停了
readme.text:
只测了一个很窄的问题：**把一条 lesson 塞给模型，它会复述回多少？** 指标是 `lesson_hit_rate`——被注入
lesson 里的命令有多大概率出现在回答里。读数字前先读设定：本基准的场景就是**每篇 lesson 自己的标题**，
注入的正是同一篇，不发生任何检索调用，也不检查正确性。所以它测的是 RAG 的**复述**那一半：MisakaNet 有
用所必需，但**不是"检索能找到东西"的证据**。

这个项目已**暂停**。2026-09-22 两次独立运行、每次约 500 个场景：带 lesson **46.1%**，不带 **23.3%**。
留下的是最后一次快照加它的日期记录——[`docs/benchmarks/latest.json`](docs/benchmarks/latest.json)。

下表由 [`scripts/update_readme_benchmark.py`](scripts/update_readme_benchmark.py) 生成，请勿手改。

每次运行的文件：[`docs/benchmarks/`](docs/benchmarks/) · 指标定义：`METRIC_DEFINITION`
（[`scripts/benchmark_workers_ai.py`](scripts/benchmark_workers_ai.py)）。

**1. 报一个语料里没有的失败。** 先检索，再 `misakanet_submit_intake`——不要账号、不要邮箱、不要 token，
五行就够。它会变成一个被跟踪的 issue。

**2. 复用一条 lesson，留下痕迹。** "这有用"这一票记为 `E3` 提示，不冒充证明。真正的证明更安静：
你的检索会被匿名计为"又一个不同客户端用过这篇"。

**你得到的回报是署名**：lesson 在 frontmatter 里引用产生它的 intake（`source:`、`provenance.issue:`），
管线可以出一张写明 lesson 与证据等级的回执。

这里没有赏金：本仓库不付钱、也不承诺。部分 issue 带有本仓自动化添加的第三方悬赏横幅，不由我们发放——
见[贡献](#贡献)。

挑一条通道即可，彼此独立。

| 我想要… | 命令 | 动了什么 |
|---|---|---|
| 让我的助手能检索课程 | `npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup` | 把 MCP 端点写进各助手配置；可选规则块与钩子 |
| **Claude Code**，以插件形式 | `/plugin marketplace add Ikalus1988/MisakaNet` 然后 `/plugin install misakanet@misakanet` | 托管的 MCP 工具，无需安装器、无本地进程 |
| **DeepSeek Harness** | `dsh plugin --profile web add misakanet` | `mcp__misakanet__*` 工具与会话面板 |
| 自己调端点 | [头五分钟](#头五分钟)里的 `curl` | 什么都不动 |
| 在自己的代码里用库 | `pip install misakanet-core` | 什么都不动 |

**两个包的坑**（它造成过一次真实的安装失败，#1849）：

| 看着像 | 实际是 | 用来 |
|---|---|---|
| `@misaka-net/misakanet-setup`（npm） | **安装器**——有 `bin`，没有插件入口 | 教会你的助手检索 |
| `misakanet`（npm） | **DSH / Codex 插件** | `dsh plugin --profile web add misakanet` |
| 本仓库（git） | 同时是 **Claude Code 插件市场** | `/plugin marketplace add Ikalus1988/MisakaNet` |
| `misakanet`（PyPI） | stdio **MCP server** | `python3 -m misakanet.server` |
| `misakanet-core`（PyPI） | **库**（纯标准库 BM25） | `from misakanet.search import search_lessons` |

**读是匿名且不限次数的**（同一地址的突发窗口是速度限制，不是配额），且 8 个工具的能力边界都有明文。**注册只为写入**：解锁
`misakanet_write_lesson` 与 `misakanet_preflight`（[原因](AGENTS.md#33-注册与配额)）。

验证安装：`npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup --verify`；卸载：`--uninstall`。
前置：安装器要 Node ≥ 18，库与 stdio server 要 Python ≥ 3.11。Python 3.10 已于 2026-10-01 结束支持（EOL），所以本版本需要 3.11 或更新——升级本包之前先升级解释器。
